verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms an OpenAPI document is downloadable at https://clerk.com/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains an "openapi" key). Content quoted from that file describes Backend API resources such as allow-lists and block-lists, showing it is a real, machine-readable spec of Clerk's API. missing for 10: first-party docs that advertise or explain the spec and its versioning, and evidence of which APIs it covers (e.g., Frontend API alongside Backend API).
